shadingCriterion: State Association Status & National Competitive Tier

states.name: Maharashtra
states.facts: Birthplace of modern codified Kho Kho in 1914 at Deccan Gymkhana, Pune. Highest number of Senior National Championship victories in Indian sporting history.
states.activeTournament: Maharashtra State Senior Championship & Chhatrapati Shivaji State Cup

states.name: Andhra Pradesh
states.hub: Vijayawada, Guntur (KL University Hub), Visakhapatnam, Tirupati
states.facts: Hosted the historic First Senior Men's National Championship in Vijayawada (1959–60). KL University (Koneru Lakshmaiah University) in Vaddeswaram is a premier academic and training center producing national and inter-university medalists.
states.activeTournament: AP Inter-District Senior Championship & Krishna Valley Trophy

states.name: Karnataka
states.facts: Regular winners and finalists in South Zone and All India Inter-University championships, with University of Mysore and Mangalore University winning consecutive AIU crowns.
states.activeTournament: Karnataka Senior State Championship & Mysore Dussehra Sports Meet

states.name: Telangana
states.hub: Hyderabad, Warangal, Nizamabad, Aziz Nagar (KLH Campus)
states.facts: Home franchise to Telugu Yoddhas in Ultimate Kho Kho. Rapid expansion across university campuses including KLH Aziz Nagar and Osmania University.
states.activeTournament: Telangana Premier Kho Kho League & Inter-District Championship

states.name: Odisha
states.facts: Odisha Juggernauts won the inaugural Ultimate Kho Kho title in 2022. Host of UKK Season 2 at Cuttack. State-of-the-art sports science and Kho Kho high performance center.
states.activeTournament: Odisha State Kho Kho League & Kalinga Cup

states.name: Gujarat
states.facts: Historic ties through Maharaja Sayajirao Gaekwad's patronage in Baroda. Gujarat Giants clinched UKK Season 2 Championship in 2024.
states.activeTournament: Gujarat State Inter-District Championship & Khel Mahakumbh

states.name: Delhi (NCT)
states.category: 2025 World Cup Host City / Northern Power
states.hub: Indira Gandhi Indoor Stadium, Tyagaraj Stadium, Chhatrasal
notablePlayers: Nasreen Shaikh (Arjuna Award 2023 / World Cup Gold)
states.facts: Proud host of the 1st Kho Kho World Cup in January 2025. Captain Nasreen Shaikh led the Indian Women's team to historic gold and received the Arjuna Award.
states.activeTournament: Delhi State Senior Cup & North Zone Inter-State

states.name: Kerala
states.facts: Renowned for exceptional defender squads and footwork drills. University of Calicut and Kerala University are powerhouse podium finishers in AIU national tournaments.

states.name: Tamil Nadu
states.hub: Chennai (Chennai Quick Guns), Coimbatore (Bharathiar Univ), Madurai
states.facts: Base for UKK franchise Chennai Quick Guns (runners-up in Season 2). Thousands of collegiate squads compete in Tamil Nadu Inter-Collegiate and CM Trophy.
states.activeTournament: Tamil Nadu Senior State Championship & CM Trophy

states.name: West Bengal
states.facts: Hosted the 1st Asian Kho Kho Championship in 1987. Deep institutional roots in schools, universities, and rural clubs across Bengal.
states.activeTournament: Bengal State Championship & Netaji Gold Cup

states.name: Punjab
states.facts: Netaji Subhas National Institute of Sports (NIS) in Patiala trains national coaches in tactical biomechanics and conditioning.

states.name: Uttar Pradesh
states.facts: Vast grassroots player base with over 45 district affiliated bodies sending representatives to national school and senior games.
states.activeTournament: UP Senior State Championship & Ganga Trophy
